notes.title: A Petit Update for Mon Amour
notes.notes:
We have a mini update for all you lovers and fighters out there:
[list]
[*] Skippable Ending
Watched it once and want to get back to scoring? Now you can!
[*] Play with any button
Any button (ABXY / ○×△□) will now work to climb/ascend[/list]
We hope this helps your kissing endeavors!
